before: Pasted word processor HTML lost its tracked changes, suggesting mode pasted plain text only, and a suggested deletion of a simple field without a saved result changed nothing.
after: Pasted HTML lands its insertions, deletions, mark, formatting, and row revisions; a suggesting-mode rich paste lands as one tracked insertion through the fragment paste; and a suggested simple-field deletion writes the complex field inside one w:del.
reason: All three write existing WordprocessingML revision shapes through the existing fragment paste and tracked-delete operations. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization are unchanged.
